description: Replacement of the existing front/side fencing and gate involving addition of new gate to side elevation.
decision_conditions: The proposed means of enclosure, by virtue of its design and appearance, would fail to preserve and enhance the character and appearance of the Bush Hill Park Conservation Area, resulting in less than substantial harm to the significance of this designated heritage asset. No public benefits have been identified that would outweigh this harm. Furthermore, insufficient information has been submitted regarding the detailed design and appearance of the proposed gate(s), preventing a full and informed assessment of their impact on the character and appearance of the Conservation Area. The proposal therefore conflicts with Section 72(1) of the Planning (Listed Buildings and Conservation Areas) Act 1990, the NPPF (2026), Policy HC1 of the London Plan (2021), Policy CP31 of the Enfield Core Strategy (2010), Policies DMD37 and DMD44 of the Enfield Development Management Document (2014), and the Bush Hill Park Conservation Area Character Appraisal (2015).
application_type_full: Householder planning & demolition in a conservation area
